speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Foot of the stair, Master Cowley. That is as far as this house allows a caller.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have today's part already learned. I came to ask which of the marked cuts is current.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The second. I was going to tell you the reason for the second, and not the first.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: A reason will not help an entrance. I said so in January, and a stair is no place to start again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then roll against roll. Yours and mine, and no why carried off the step.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have the marked one. If the second is current, I play the second.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The second is current. Leave the first where it is.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And leave the stair when you have said it. He is not going with you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going. I resent how sensible the arrangement is.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Sensible is a part learned and a man left where he can mend. The afternoon can spare you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It can spare him, and it will. He eats what I call broth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You may call it broth. I shall call it water.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then drink the water, and let me have the afternoon. I did not come to be told a man's night.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You did not come above this step. The foot of the stair is the visit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Friar was irritable at first light, and I was worse. I struck eleven lines. I kept none. Do not ask me for them.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will not ask. A struck line is not an entrance either.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Oil of cloves, and wool in the cheek, and two hours' sleep at most. That is the night you are covering.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I am covering the part, not the night. Keep the wool. I have the roll.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He will keep the wool, and he will keep the house. Mark me. When you go, the street door shuts.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Play it plain. If a man in the yard wants the reason, he may want it. He will not have it from me today.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: He will not have it from me either. An entrance is the cut, and the cut is the second.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are agreed, and the agreement is as sensible as I said I resented.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Resent it upstairs, after you have eaten. The street is not your office this morning.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have the second. I will not come back for the first. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. Play it plain.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Plain, and gone. I am shutting the street door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it. There is broth, and there is a jaw, and there is no more of a morning than that.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit when he is gone. The broth is hot, and the crust is not for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit. I will not chew a crust to prove I might have gone out.
